ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white pixels dominate approximately 75% of the fluke surface area, contrasted against a deep black central wedge and peripheral margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity white contiguous zones on the left and right lobes; bisected by a low-intensity black isosceles-trapezoid wedge at the peduncle junction; low-intensity black continuous band along the trailing edge and distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and a vertical depth reaching approximately 12% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel amplitudes varying from 3 to 12 pixels; most pronounced and jagged on the distal 25% of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-concave curvature from the median notch extending towards the tips, with a slight upward vertical translation at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle attachment points) located on the black distal tips and lower margins of the central black wedge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four distinct, near-parallel dark vertical linear disruptions (rake marks) on the lower-inner portion of the left white lobe; fine diagonal scratches on the far-left lobe field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily textured and irregular margins on the distal tips, characterized by dense white scarring and physical erosion of the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Feathered/mottled pixel transition zone between the central black peduncle area and the white lobes, featuring a 'dripping' pattern of black speckles.
